why: Defects in the pinned OAI that this repository fixes locally until they are reported upstream. Patches are applied at build time; the pinned tree src/oai and its build builds/oai-zmq-release are never modified. check-oai-local-patches.sh verifies every entry.

zmq_module.why: The pinned OAI ZMQ radio driver sleeps in zmq_poll for up to 10 ms while a REP reply is owed, which paces the whole lock-step gNB <-> broker <-> nrUE chain to ~0.3x real time (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S9). The driver also has no AGC: samples reach the UE PHY at the far end's level, and at OCUDU's default 12 dB back-off (~55 dB digital power, above the UE's TARGET_RX_POWER of 50 dB) 64QAM PDSCH NACKs 69-89%; oai-zmq-rx-gain.patch adds zmq.[n].rx_gain_db, which the OAI gates set (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S12). Without AVX2 (aarch64) the RX float->int16 conversion also truncates instead of rounding and saturating; oai-zmq-rx-saturate.patch makes it match the x86 SIMD path (a latent defect: no sample came near full scale in S12). The OAI gates load this module by default; OCUDU_NATIVE_OAI_ZMQ_MODULE=stock opts out.

optional.reason: S10: +3% slots/s at 100 MHz unpinned, no gain once the platform CPU split is applied (2,060 vs 2,077 slots/s); a measurement knob only, never built into the default module.

Not built into the default module yet (S17, 2026-10-02). NEON paths for the cf32<->int16 conversion on aarch64 (without AVX2 the scalar cleanup loop converts every sample in the UE rx_poll_thread). Measured on GB10, 100 MHz 2x2, as a custom module: UE per-message ingest round trip 469 -> 236 us p50; the pipelined loop real-time factor unchanged (0.72-0.80), the stock sequential loop +5 % (0.65-0.67 -> 0.707). Applies after oai-zmq-rx-saturate.patch. Promote once a --probe pair exists; gates skip ue_rx_gain_db for a custom shlibpath.

ue.why: The pinned nrUE 2-layer equaliser (nr_dlsch_mmse) wraps int16 at OCUDU's TX level, so rank-2 PDSCH NACKs unless the gNB backs off ~24 dB (docs/plans/m6-rank2-su-mimo-live.md 8.1/8.7). Its CSI rank estimator (nr_csi_rs_ri_estimation) accumulates Hh*H into an uninitialised stack array, so under full-band PDSCH load the condition number comes from stack garbage and the UE reports RI=1 (50 MHz 2x2: rank 2 on ~20% of PDSCH); oai-csi-ri-amf-init.patch zeroes it (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S14). The OAI 2x2 gate runs this UE by default; OCUDU_NATIVE_OAI_UE=stock opts out.
